title: Yoniso
text: 2. -yathayidam bhikkhave yonisomanasikārasampadā || || 3. Yonisomanasikārasampannassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pātikaṅkhaṃ ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- amaggam bahulīkarissati || || Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || pa [pe] || sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || pa || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- viraga- nirodhanissitam vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno a- a- maggam bhāveti a- amaggam bahulīkarotī ti || || [page 037] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 37 II. RĀGAVINAYA-
